headline: Go to emergency department now.

reasons.finding: extends beyond incision line with reddish spots
open wound with yellowish-orange tissue, redness beyond line, yellowish crust

steps: Go to the nearest A&E/Emergency Department.
Keep the wound covered with a clean dry cloth if you can.
Do not eat or drink until you are seen.
message_to_team: I have a fever of 38.4°C, my wound is open with yellow/green discharge and redness spreading beyond the stitch line. I am heading to A&E now. Please let me know if you need any more information.

second_check.note: Fever with wound dehiscence, spreading purplish discoloration, and purulent discharge indicate a serious surgical site infection requiring immediate emergency evaluation.

photo_words: The wound is open in the center with the edges apart, revealing a dark gap and yellowish-orange tissue; no stitches, staples, or glue are visible. Redness and a faint purplish discoloration extend beyond the incision line, with small reddish spots nearby. Yellowish crusting or discharge is present at the margins of the open gap. Swelling is not clearly visible. Faint purplish bruising is visible on the surrounding skin.
